title: sdks: unify auth/retries + streaming ergonomics across Python/TS/Go; parity fixes and version bumps
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Bumped SDK versions to v1.93.0 across Python/TypeScript/Go. Unifies auth and retry behavior, improves streaming ergonomics and parity. No breaking API changes for public surface; internal refactor only.
description:
Motivation: We maintain three SDKs (python, typescript, go) and have diverging behaviors around auth, retries (default backoff, idempotency), and streaming ergonomics. This PR unifies those behaviors, fixes parity gaps, and bumps SDK versions to v1.93.0.

What changed: consolidated auth token refresh logic into a shared contract, standardized retry/backoff config and default values, improved streaming iterator ergonomics (sync/async parity), and small API ergonomic tweaks in each SDK to match the canonical design. Also includes minor docs and changelog updates.

Checklist:
- [x] Unify auth refresh and credential sources across SDKs
- [x] Standardize retry/backoff defaults and expose config objects
- [x] Streaming APIs: provide consistent iterator interface and cancellation hooks
- [x] Parity fixes: error codes, headers, and telemetry tags aligned
- [x] Bump package versions to v1.93.0 and update changelogs
- [x] Run full CI and integration tests

Compatibility notes: No breaking changes for typical usage. Some advanced consumers of internal retry internals may need to migrate to public config objects. See changelog for migration steps.
commits:
1) consolidate-auth-retries: factor auth/token refresh into SDK core (Aisha Patel)
2) python-streaming-ergonomics: add async iterator + cancel() hook (Aisha Patel)
3) ts-streaming-parity: expose sync/async generator helpers and typed events (Connor Liu)
4) go-retries-config: add RetryPolicy struct + default backoff (Marta Kaczmarek)
5) bump-versions-and-changelog (Aisha Patel)
